a.lede: A newly identified advanced persistent threat (APT) group tracked as UAT-11473 was observed exploiting CVE-2026-20127, an authentication-bypass flaw in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controllers, to deploy a custom malware framework called KeyDrift. [...]
a.title: Hackers exploit Cisco SD-WAN flaw to deploy custom KeyDrift malware

b.lede: The U.S. government cyber agency warns that hackers have figured out a way to exploit the popular PHP software, used in 70% of the web's software.
b.title: US government says hackers are now exploiting critical PHP web bugs
